title: Rooming with Red Norvo and the Maine stranding
summary: He stays with Red during his marital quarrels and recalls the Rudy Vallee band stranded in Maine, where he wrote for it.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Was Red with you at the time?
No, Red made up with Mildred.
The two of you were roommates for a while, weren't you? When he was on the outs with Mildred?

Yes. One time--this may have been before that even, when we were playing the Apollo and I didn't want to commute, I stayed at the Teresa, and there I do recall getting some strange looks, because people just didn't do that. I was very naive and I didn't know anything about that. I had no sense of

anything of that nature.
Then Red got tangled up with
Mildred and then came to stay there a couple
of nights and then up in Maine, having been
in New Orleans, there was a Rudy Vallee band
and they got stranded in Maine too.

Red went up on that, Mildred
came up and before Mildred came, Red roomed
with me too, always encouraging me to write.
I tried writing for that band; Tootie wrote
for the band too.

I guess it was before that I
had done the first thing for Mildred in the
theatre in New Jersey, where Barnet had some-
how got up with Mildred, through Red, I guess.
